experiments.label: H1
experiments.title: Four days of speed
experiments.observation: Ridge RMSE 88.78 km/s versus 89.95 for the RBF SVM. Little trend skill (r = 0.070).

experiments.label: H2
experiments.title: Recurrence and in-situ measurements
experiments.observation: Multivariate tree RMSE 74.83 km/s, a 15.72% reduction from H1. Recurrence alone accounts for most of the gain.

experiments.label: H3
experiments.title: GPU residual learning
experiments.observation: RMSE 74.47 versus 75.15 km/s for the linear reference: 0.90% improvement, below the 2% threshold.

experiments.label: H4
experiments.title: Average different model errors
experiments.observation: Half tree, half neural forecast reached 73.85 km/s. Gain: 1.31% over the accepted tree; 0.83% over the best single neural model.

experiments.label: E5
experiments.title: Frozen original-holdout evaluation
experiments.observation: Lower five-fold mean RMSE (77.87 vs WindNet 80.28), but lower correlation (0.515 vs 0.550). Fold 5 favors WindNet (76.35 vs 78.06). The confidence interval against short ridge includes zero.

experiments.label: E6
experiments.title: Controlled feature ablations
experiments.observation: Removing the 27-day band costs 4.50 km/s; 54-day band costs 0.67; magnetic variables cost 0.21; removing plasma is essentially unchanged. Longer recent history alone does not help.

experiments.label: H7
experiments.title: Original eleven-channel SDO proposal
experiments.observation: Excluded two channels after the quality audit; no scientific model run.

experiments.label: H8
experiments.title: Scalar SDO features in classical ensembles
experiments.observation: Met its stated fast-error guard against classical controls; prior neural champion was missing and is supplied in H11.

experiments.label: H9
experiments.title: Fast-case weights and component ablations
experiments.observation: Fast error improved with an overall-error trade-off. The cumulative drift is retained in the report.

experiments.label: H10
experiments.title: Mean-one normalization proposal
experiments.observation: Cancelled without model fitting to repair the missing prior-champion comparison first.

experiments.label: H11
experiments.title: Carry forward the prior neural champion
experiments.observation: Faithful recipe retraining plus SDO additions; no candidate met the preregistered overall-improvement gate.

experiments.label: H12
experiments.title: Fixed stability audit
experiments.observation: Integrity passed; no H11 adoption. Conditional resampling did not change the portfolio.

experiments.label: E13
experiments.title: Locked WindNet and prior-winner comparison
experiments.scope: Original five holdouts; previously viewed historical data
experiments.observation: One-shot fixed 15-model panel: fast-error gains, weaker event detection; neither balanced-improvement gate passed. No tuning followed.

reading_note: Development CV and historical test results have different roles. Supported means the stated experiment criterion, not overall superiority or fresh confirmation.
